    Co-op
    
    
    Up to four keepers, one lighthouse. Every keeper fights with their own lantern, weapon, ability and upgrades.
    
    
    
    
    
      
    
      
      
    
      
    
        
    
    
    
    
    
      
    
      
    You can still play using the Local network (a computer running the co-op server), a phone hotspot, or QR pairing (Phone to phone).
    
      
    
    
    
    
    
      
      
      
      
    
      
      
    
    
    
    
    
      
    Developer mode: a relay on this computer (npm run coop-server or npm run coop:local).
    
      
      
    
    
    
    
    
      
    Phone to phone (no server)
    
      
    For devices on the same Wi-Fi or one phone's hotspot. The host shows a code, a partner scans it and shows a reply. Pair each partner in turn.
    
      
    
    
    
    
    
      
    
      
    
        
        
    
      
      
    
      
      
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    Online rooms need an account and an internet connection. On the same Wi-Fi, the desktop app can host (Local network), or two phones can pair with QR codes, no account needed. If a connection drops, the game reconnects and keeps your seat for a minute.
